repo_path.label: Repository path
repo_path.description: Git checkout of your NixOS configuration (for example ~/system-configs). The indicator stays inactive until this is set.

poll_interval_s.label: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval_s.description: Fallback git status check. File changes are also picked up immediately via inotify.

fetch_interval_min.label: Fetch interval (minutes)
fetch_interval_min.description: How often to git fetch to detect when the upstream is ahead. 0 disables fetching.

hide_when_clean.label: Hide when clean
hide_when_clean.description: Hide the dot when there are no uncommitted changes and the branch is not behind its upstream. A misconfigured indicator is always shown.
